intuition: A new value can only create or join an interval next to its insertion point.

brute_force.approach: Store every value and sort and regroup the entire set for each interval request.
brute_force.time: addNum O(1), getIntervals O(n log n)

optimal.approach: Keep sorted, disjoint intervals and merge the predecessor and successor when adjacent.
optimal.time: addNum O(n) due to list insertion, getIntervals O(n)

edge_cases: Adding an existing value leaves intervals unchanged.
A value may bridge two adjacent intervals into one.
